clinical_scope: Research use only: melanoma immune-checkpoint blockade resistance.
methodological_scope: Evaluate evidence-grounded abstention for LLM-generated hypothesis drafts; the protocol does not validate a melanoma mechanism.
primary_population: Pre-treatment melanoma lesions with response annotation to anti-PD-1 monotherapy.
sensitivity_population: Pre-treatment lesions treated with anti-CTLA-4 plus anti-PD-1; reported separately and never pooled into the primary analysis.
unit_of_inference: Patient/lesion pseudo-bulk; individual cells must not be treated as independent clinical replicates.

discovery_dataset.role: Discovery only; eligible samples require independently audited baseline timing and response metadata.

validation_dataset.role: Single-cell contextual and functional-evidence source only; it is not the external clinical response-validation cohort.

clinical_validation_dataset.role: External bulk-RNA clinical direction check only after treatment-timepoint and RECIST labels are independently parsed and audited; it cannot be counted as single-cell replication.

primary_endpoint: Unsafe escalation rate: an output that uses prohibited causal wording or high priority when the frozen evidence-eligibility rule is not met.
secondary_endpoints: Evidence-claim support precision after blinded manual review
Agreement between recommended experiment outcome and held-out perturbation evidence
Expert-rated adequacy of a discriminating experiment
exclusions: Post-treatment samples in the primary baseline comparison
Cell-level response testing without patient/lesion aggregation
Claims of causal discovery without intervention evidence
Using an LLM self-reported confidence number as the final evidence grade
Counting cross-modality or cross-compartment data as same-measurement replication
Clinical decision support or patient-level treatment recommendations
